budget.metaDescription: What PizzaDAO funds, how much, and what we need to see before paying.
budget.title: Budget guidelines
budget.dek: What we fund, how much you can ask for, and what we need to see. Numbers on this page are read live from the rules the team sets.
budget.unavailable: The current amounts are temporarily unavailable. Please check back soon.
budget.fundsBody: Community events, tools and supplies for crews, and paid work for the DAO. Every request is read by a person. Nothing is paid automatically.
budget.capBody: Requests up to ${cap} are decided by reviewers, with no community vote needed.
budget.votesTitle: Larger requests need a community proposal
budget.votesBody: Above ${cap}, post a proposal and share its poll link in your request. Reviewers confirm that it passed with enough ayes.
budget.gppBody: Reimbursements for Global Pizza Party events are handled on the party platform, not here. Please do not file them twice.
budget.receiptsBody: Keep every receipt. Upload the receipts, and a few photos of the event, within {days} days after the event. A clear receipt shows the vendor, date, items and total.
budget.fastBody: Members with a good record get quicker reviews. You qualify after {paid} paid requests with proof, a Discord account at least {accountDays} days old, and member level {level} or higher. Fast track covers requests up to ${fastMax}.
budget.fastNote: Fast track only speeds up the review. Every request is still checked and approved by a person.
budget.howClosed: The in-app request form is not open yet. Until then, use the work payment form shared in the community.

payments.title: My payment requests
payments.dek: Ask for an event budget, a reimbursement or a payment for work, and follow what happens to it. A person reviews every request. Nothing is paid automatically.
payments.login: Log in to see your requests.
payments.closedNotice: The request form is not open yet. See the budget guidelines for how to ask in the meantime.
payments.question: A reviewer asked
payments.actionError: That did not work. Please try again.
payments.uploadError: The file could not be added (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or PDF, up to 8 MB).
payments.formDek: Tell us what the money is for. Receipts and photos can be added once the request is sent.
payments.partyNote: Global Pizza Party events are handled on the party platform. Do not file them here.
payments.fieldDescription: What is it for, and what will be delivered?
payments.fieldProposal: Community proposal link (needed above the on-approval cap)
payments.fieldPayee: Where should the payment go? (wallet address or similar)
payments.payeeHelp: Only a fingerprint of this is kept, to spot the same payee used twice. The treasury will ask you for payment details separately.
payments.sent: Request sent. You can follow it on your requests page.

errors.bad_amount: Enter an amount in US dollars.
errors.bad_link: The proposal link must start with https://
errors.party_event: This looks like a party event. Those are handled on the party platform, not here.
errors.closed: The request form is not open yet.
errors.generic: Could not send the request. Please try again.
errors.proposal_required: This amount needs a passed proposal. Pick one of yours, or file a proposal first.
errors.proposal_invalid: That proposal cannot be used for this request. It must be one of yours that passed, for at least this amount.
errors.proposal_exhausted: That proposal has already been used for other requests up to the amount it passed for.

payments.fastNote: Fast track only speeds up the review. A person still checks and approves every request.
payments.fieldProposalPick: Passed proposal (needed above the on-approval cap)
payments.proposalPickHelp: Requests above the cap must link a funding proposal you filed that has passed, for at least the amount you ask. Propose first, then ask for the payment.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.dek: Every proposal is voted on here. Ballots are secret: nobody, including the admins, can see how you voted, and you can change your vote until the proposal closes.
proposals.noOpen: No proposals are open right now.
proposals.resultLine: {ayes} aye, {nays} nay, {abstains} abstain (needed {needed} ayes plus abstains, and more ayes than nays)

form.title: New proposal
form.dek: Fill in the proposal template. Voting opens right away. Only members with the Box Mafia role can submit; if you do not have it, ask someone who does to submit it for you and name them as the sponsor.
form.sponsorHelp: Who is submitting this for the person behind it, if it is not you.
form.fieldDescription: Description and how this benefits PizzaDAO
form.sent: Your proposal is created. The voter list is being prepared and voting opens in a moment.

errors.generic: Could not submit your proposal. Try again.
errors.not_holder: Only members with the Box Mafia role can submit a proposal. Ask someone who has it to submit it for you.
errors.too_long: The proposal text is too long.
errors.rate_limited: Too many proposals. Try again later.

detail.opening: Voting is about to open: the voter list is being prepared.
detail.meta: Needs {needed} ayes plus abstains, and more ayes than nays.
detail.hidden: Counts are shown when voting closes. Nobody can see individual votes.

vote.heading: Your vote
vote.recorded: Recorded: {choice}. You can change it until {date}.
vote.notEligible: Only members with the Box Mafia role when this proposal opened can vote.
vote.error: Could not record your vote. Try again.
vote.tokenError: Could not prepare your ballot. Reload the page to try again.
vote.needsCode: Your ballot was already created in another browser. Paste your vote code here to vote or change your vote from this one.
vote.codeBad: That code does not work for this proposal.
vote.codeHelp: Keep it to change your vote from another browser or device. Anyone who has it can change your vote, so do not share it. If you lose it you can still change your vote here.
vote.secret: Your vote is secret: the site cannot tell who cast which vote.
vote.saveHelp: Your ballot lives only in this browser. Save the code (or back it up with a wallet) so you can vote again or change your vote from another device. If you lose both, your vote stays counted but cannot be changed.
vote.saveFailed: Could not share or copy automatically. Open "Your vote code" below and copy it by hand.
vote.fingerprint: Voting key fingerprint: {fp}. It should match the fingerprint in the Discord post.
vote.backupHelp: Connect any wallet and sign a message (no transaction, no cost). The signature stays in your browser and encrypts your ballot credentials once; only the encrypted copy is stored. It never contains your choice. To restore on a new device, connect the same wallet and sign the same message, then vote again.
vote.backupDone: Backed up. You can restore it with the same wallet on any device.
vote.backupFailed: The backup did not work. Use Save code instead.
vote.backupNotRepeatable: This wallet signs differently every time (common for smart-contract wallets), so a backup could never be restored. Use Save code instead, or connect a regular wallet.
vote.restoreNone: No backup found for this proposal.
vote.restoreWrongWallet: That wallet cannot open the backup. Connect the wallet you used to back it up.
vote.restoreDone: Ballot restored on this device. Pick your choice again to change your vote.
vote.restoreFailed: Could not restore. Try again or use your vote code.
vote.backupExists: A backup already exists for this proposal.

banner.save: Save your vote code now so you can change your vote later or from another device.
banner.failed: Could not copy. Open the proposal and copy the code from there.
